blocks.prompt: 17. Encrypt the word "CODE" by multiplying the complex encryption key \(k = 2 - i\). Then decrypt it back to the original word.
blocks.explanation: Yeh cryptography (khufia paigham ka ilm) ka sawal hai, jaise kitab ki Example 18 mein. Har letter ko ek number diya jata hai (A = 1, B = 2, ..., Z = 26) aur use complex number banaya jata hai jis ka imaginary part 0 ho. Encrypt (chhupana): har number ko key \(k\) se zarb karein. Decrypt (wapas parhna): k se taqseem karein, yani \(k^{-1}\) (multiplicative inverse, woh number jis se k ko zarb karein to 1 aaye) se zarb karein. Socho jaise taala aur chaabi: k se taala lagta hai aur \(k^{-1}\) se khulta hai.
steps:
Given (diya gaya hai): lafz CODE, key \(k = 2 - i\), aur A = 1, B = 2, ..., Z = 26 (Example 18 ki tarah).
To find (maloom karna hai): encrypted numbers, aur phir wapas asal lafz.
Method (tareeqa): encrypted \(= z \times k\); decrypted \(= (z \times k) \div k = (z \times k) \times k^{-1}\).

Qadam 1: Letters ko complex numbers banayein
\[C = 3 + 0i, \quad O = 15 + 0i\]
\[D = 4 + 0i, \quad E = 5 + 0i\]
Kyun: C teesra letter hai, O pandrahwan, D chautha, E paanchwan. Kitab har letter ko imaginary part 0 deti hai.

Qadam 2: Encrypt (k se zarb)
\[(3 + 0i)(2 - i) = 6 - 3i\]
\[(15 + 0i)(2 - i) = 30 - 15i\]
\[(4 + 0i)(2 - i) = 8 - 4i\]
\[(5 + 0i)(2 - i) = 10 - 5i\]
Kyun: real number ko \(2 - i\) se zarb karne se dono parts us number se zarb ho jaate hain (\(3 \times 2 = 6\), \(3 \times (-i) = -3i\)). Khufia paigham: \(6 - 3i,\ 30 - 15i,\ 8 - 4i,\ 10 - 5i\). Ab koi bhi yeh numbers dekh kar asaani se CODE nahi parh sakta.

Qadam 3: Key ka inverse nikaalein
\[k^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{2 - i} \times \dfrac{2 + i}{2 + i}\]
\[= \dfrac{2 + i}{4 + 1} = \dfrac{2 + i}{5}\]
Kyun: k se taqseem karna \(k^{-1}\) se zarb karne ke barabar hai. \(\frac{1}{2 - i}\) ke neeche i hai, is liye upar neeche conjugate \(2 + i\) se zarb kiya taake neeche real ho jaye: \((2 - i)(2 + i) = 4 - i^{2} = 4 + 1 = 5\).

Qadam 4: Pehla number poora decrypt karein
\[(6 - 3i) \cdot \dfrac{2 + i}{5}\]
\[= \dfrac{12 + 6i - 6i - 3i^{2}}{5}\]
\[= \dfrac{12 + 3}{5} = 3 \;\Rightarrow\; C\]
Kyun: \(i^{2} = -1\), is liye \(-3i^{2} = +3\); \(6i\) aur \(-6i\) cancel ho gaye aur wapas ek real number aaya, jo letter ki value hai: 3, yani C.
Dhyan dein: agar decrypt ke baad imaginary part 0 na aaye to samajh lein ke kahin hisaab mein ghalti hai.

Qadam 5: Baqi numbers decrypt karein
\[(30 - 15i)\cdot\dfrac{2 + i}{5} = \dfrac{75}{5} = 15 \Rightarrow O\]
\[(8 - 4i)\cdot\dfrac{2 + i}{5} = \dfrac{20}{5} = 4 \Rightarrow D\]
\[(10 - 5i)\cdot\dfrac{2 + i}{5} = \dfrac{25}{5} = 5 \Rightarrow E\]
Kyun: bilkul Qadam 4 wala kaam (maslan \(30 \cdot 2 + 15 = 75\)). Poori table jawab ke neeche di gayi hai.

Tasdeeq (check): \(k \cdot k^{-1} = (2 - i)\cdot\frac{2 + i}{5} = \frac{4 + 1}{5} = 1\), is liye \(k^{-1}\) se zarb karna k se zarb ko bilkul ulta kar deta hai.
Kyun: \(z \times k \times k^{-1} = z \times 1 = z\). Yahi wajah hai ke asal lafz bina kisi kami ke wapas mil jata hai.
